$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (endoflife-date-source, part 2/2). Seeds one mapping + synchronization + job triple per curated product (design.md Decision 2 — one Synchronization per product keeps each SynchronizationContract's (synchronizationId, originId) collision-proof; discovery.md Finding 4). Companion to endoflife-date-source.json (schemas + source + eolProduct seeds), split for reviewability per tasks.md Task 2.

objects.name: endoflife.date PHP cycles mapping
objects.description: Maps one /api/php.json cycle entry to an eolCycle object. `product` is the literal "php" (renders verbatim through the Twig mapping engine — no {{ }} markers; design.md Decision 4). `discontinued` uses an explicit `{{ discontinued|default('') }}` Twig template (not a bare dot-path copy) because endoflife.date does not report this key for every product/cycle — a bare field-name mapping value falls through to the Twig-literal branch when the key is absent, which would wrongly write the literal word "discontinued" instead of an empty string.

objects.name: endoflife.date — PHP cycles
objects.description: Daily pull of PHP's release-cycle lifecycle data from https://endoflife.date/api/php.json into register openconnector, schema eolCycle. `resultsPosition: "_root"` is REQUIRED (the endpoint's JSON body is a bare top-level array — design.md Decision 5); `deletionRatioThreshold` is raised to 0.5 because this product's total cycle count can be small enough that retiring one legitimately-removed cycle exceeds the engine's 0.10 default guard (design.md Decision 7).

objects.name: endoflife.date — PHP cycles sync
objects.description: Daily cron dispatch of the endoflife-date-php-cycles synchronization via the existing, generic SynchronizationAction job class. `arguments.synchronizationId` addresses the synchronization by its @self.slug (verified by reading GetObject::find()/MagicMapper::findInRegisterSchemaTable() — identifier resolution matches on _id/_uuid/_slug/_uri; see design.md Open Questions / proposal.md Risk 3).
